What if Ancient Rome discovered electricity?
No oil. No smoke. The forum burns bright all night.
Hot baths at midnight. Cold wine in summer.
He orders a jar in every house. A wire on every street. One
catch. A copper jar makes a fiftieth of a watt. About enough to tingle your tongue.
To heat one small bath, you need six hundred thousand jars. Rome has
nine hundred baths. That's half a billion jars. That's real. So the Emperor
taxes every copper roof in the empire.
Temples. Statues. The coins in your hand. Your
sister's lamp is next. The legion is at the door. Give them the spark. Or the city goes
to barbarians. It falls to a fuse. Part one.
